description: Read posts, full post detail, saved media, status totals or calendar within ONE Agency Workspace. Viewer can read permitted content; writing requires separate capabilities. Detail includes publishing deferral information. List/calendar optionally filter approvalStatus; includeApproval opts in to approval fields on list/calendar/detail. Managers use approval to read current review details and a private bearer review link: return it for manual sharing only, never autonomously send it. Cursor is scoped to caller, workspace and filters.
